title: Meta's Muse AI agent downloads are surging. Here's how it compares to ChatGPT, Grok and Claude
summary_full: Meta's Muse AI personal agent tool had 730,000 and 2.5 million downloads over the roughly five-day and thirteen-day time frames after its launch.
